notes.text: CES billing uses Xero as the accounting source of truth for invoices.
The CES monthly billing automation uploads invoice and bill PDFs to Drive every cycle.
District-level portal billing visibility is a known historical gap with little precedent.
The user prefers short, scannable answers with the next step first.
Convert Clicks deploys a Softr app over an Airtable base.
The myagent desktop app ships on Windows only and never adds a macOS branch.
CES test invisibility depends on both district scope and provider assignment, not the TEST name.
Airtable API tokens live in the Windows Credential Manager, never in SQLite or the webview.
Invoices historically lived as drafts in Airtable while final versions were stored in Xero.
Use pnpm rather than npm for this project.
The request flow moves to QA, then Client Review, then Done.
Project memory is scoped to one project and never reaches a global chat.
